title: Dunkirk evacuation begins
summary: The Royal Navy, helped by hundreds of civilian small boats, began evacuating Allied soldiers trapped at Dunkirk. By 4 June more than 338,000 British and French troops had been brought to England.
reason: German armoured forces had cut off the British Expeditionary Force and French armies against the Channel coast.
significance: Saving the army allowed Britain to keep fighting, and the 'Dunkirk spirit' became a lasting part of British national memory.
